title: Diana Blass Spends the Day with AOI at SCTE TechExpo ‘26

# Diana Blass Spends the Day with AOI at SCTE TechExpo ‘26


October 28, 2026


-
-
-


At SCTE TechExpo26 in Atlanta, tech journalist Diana Blass went behind the scenes with AOI to look at where cable networks are headed next.


- **One million 1.8 GHz amplifiers sold.** AOI marks a milestone as operators accelerate their network upgrades.


- **A first look at 3.0GHz.** What can the new standards and technology do for capacity and performance?


- **Smarter networks.** How connected amplifiers, remote monitoring and software are changing the way operators manage their plant.


- **The road ahead.** What rising AI data use and continued fiber expansion mean for cable’s future.


The takeaway: the question isn’t only how much faster broadband can get, but how intelligently it can run.


Watch the full highlights video[here!](https://youtu.be/i4dXNzonqs8)
